brief:
Settler militias set fire to a Palestinian home and vehicle in the village of Osarin, located south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, Eye on Palestine reported. The assailants also spray-painted racist slogans on structures at the scene during the attack.

The incident marks another instance of settler violence directed against Palestinian communities. Such attacks have occurred repeatedly across the West Bank, targeting Palestinian property and civilians amid ongoing tensions in the territory.
